text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I need to sleep… But… the night sky this time of year is so…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I'll just stay here a little longer… before I go to bed.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega ends up sleep-deprived because of her stargazing.
